steps.content: 08:32 The first police line outside the square
The sheriff grabs one of the gangsters and points a gun at his head.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Answer me! Who ordered you here?!

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: The Legion... it's the Legion! They asked us to charge into the square at 08:30, and make a scene to distract the sheriffs! Then Zoya could... kidnap the attendees of the negotiation!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What the f...

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: This is solid evidence! Just in from the command post: Zoya broke off the negotiation with violence at <color=#fb9259>08:30</color> and attempted to attack Mr. Burns.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Alert everyone: The Legion is starting a coup. Put it down immediately!
He fishes out his walkie-talkie, but you knock it out of his hand right away.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: How dare you! Are you defying the order from the Public Security Bureau?

options: You gave me misinformation not so long ago

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Tsk! This has nothing to do with the FAC. You've been assigned here by the city council. Keep to your assigned task.

I'm the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control, and I didn't receive any orders. The Legion came to the negotiation under the endorsement of MBCC. It falls on me to find out if they're really causing any trouble.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: ...What do you want?

options: Don't worry. I just want to sort out what's going on first

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: I...I don't know anything!
You know <color=#fb9259>Earl</color>? He's the second-in-command of the Legion. He and I have an appointment. We're meeting up for a drink before our departure.

He must have some other angle by inviting me for a drink if the Legion does want to sabotage the negotiation. I'll go and meet him now. If I can ascertain that he's subversive, I'll arrest him right there and then.
He's a cunning man. I don't want him to get suspicious, so I'll only take the Sinners with me. You stay here, and we'll keep in touch.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: ...Okay. We'll wait for you here.
He steals a look at the Sinners by your side and squeezes the words out.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What's going on here? I'm confused. Why are we here? How much longer do we have to wait? Since when did you become friends with Earl?

options: I'm not his friend. It's a lie

steps.content: Apparently, the Public Security Bureau has hooked up with some gang to frame the Legion. Their plan is crude and heavy-handed, which goes to show they are determined and will carry it through by hook or by crook.
They won't tell you anything about the plan, nor will they allow you to get in the way. If your guess is correct, the reason they've allowed you and Earl to talk it out can only be...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, we've got company. They've been following us.
A group of gangsters files out of the dark alleys, each carrying a heavy-duty Mania weapon and wearing a malicious look.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: A trap? We've been tricked?

options: It's all right. They're the ones who're trapped

steps.content: Get the party started. There's no way that we'll lose to these minions. I want the leader alive. I'm gonna ask him something, with everyone else out of the way.
